note: Waseca County zoning is listed only as a legacy Minnesota Geospatial Commons file dataset (shp/gpkg/kmz). The Commons no longer exposes a resolvable download URL, the Hub has no Waseca zoning item, and the enterprise.gisdata.mn.gov us_mn_co_waseca zoning service requires a token. The county ArcGIS server (gis.wasecacounty.gov) and the county ArcGIS Online org have parcels, drainage and municipalities only, with no zoning field or layer. City of Waseca zoning is a PDF map. The Beacon viewer is not a public queryable service.
